title: Screen never turns off after automatic lock when "When locked, turn off screen" equals the dim timeout
line: After an automatic lock the screen now turns off after the "When locked, turn off screen" delay even when dimming uses the same delay
explanation: When the screen locks, DPMS registers a new idle timeout for "When locked, turn off screen" and expects it to count from the lock. KIdleTime keeps only one idle notification per length, so when dimming already had a timeout of the same length DPMS was attached to it: if dimming had already fired (dim and auto-lock at the same time), the screen never turned off; if not, it turned off counted from the last input instead of from the lock. The change adds 1 ms to the lock timeout until no other registered timeout has that length, so it gets its own notification that counts from the lock.

commits.message:
actions/dpms: turn off the locked screen when dimming has the same delay

KIdleTime keeps one idle notification per length, so the lock timeout
joined the dimming one and never fired if that had already gone off. Add
1 ms until no other timeout has that length, so it counts from the lock.

BUG: 527667

media.caption: Pure master, 4x speed: a same-length idle action fires at 30 s, the session auto-locks at 60 s with 'when locked, turn off screen' 30 s, and the lock screen stays lit to the end (150 s)
Same steps with the fix: the screen turns off at 90 s idle, 30 s after the lock
Pure master at 150 s idle: still on, 60 s after it should have turned off
With the fix at 150 s idle: off since 90 s
